name: Misia Eau de Parfum
desc:
Misia Eau de Parfum, "the spirit of art," is a fragrance inspired by the friendship between Gabrielle Chanel and Misia Sert. Olivier Polge created it as a powdery makeup scent that evokes the air of a theater backstage, made of May rose, violet, orris root, benzoin, tonka bean, and leather.

At the end of September 2016, Chanel launched the Eau de Parfum versions of its prestigious Les Exclusifs de Chanel perfume line. The new concentration will gradually completely replace the existing Eau de Toilette editions. The fragrances are available as a 75 ml and a 200 ml Eau de Parfum.

name: Beige Eau de Parfum
desc:
Beige Eau de Parfum, “a perfume that honors the unique color,” is a simplistic, yet sensual, interpretation of a hawthorn bouquet mixed with powdery freesia flowers, frangipani, and honey. Perfumer Jacques Polge wanted to reinterpret what Mademoiselle Chanel once said: ”I take refuge in beige because it’s natural."

The fragrances are available as a 75 ml and a 200 ml Eau de Parfum.
gender: women. Beige Eau de Parfum was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge. The fragrance features Frangipani, Honey, Freesia and Hawthorn

name: Sycomore Eau de Parfum
desc:
Sycomore Eau de Parfum, "a perfume of woods,” is supposed to be a woody perfume set apart from all the others and to represent the strength of wood, the rough texture of its bark, and the crackle of its branches in the summer. Smoky and spicy, this is a scent that revolves around vetiver.

The fragrance is available as a 75 ml and a 200 ml Eau de Parfum.
gender: women and men. Sycomore Eau de Parfum was launched in 2016. The fragrance features Vetiver, Cypress, Juniper, Sandalwood, Spices, Pink Pepper, Tobacco, Aldehydes and Violet

name: La Pausa Eau de Parfum
desc:
La Pausa Eau de Parfum, "a perfume of rarity," is signed by Jacques Polge and inspired by the luxury and simplicity of Mademoiselle Chanel’s summer house above the village of Roque Brune. The elegant woody-floral scent reveals different facets of iris: earthy, powdery, shimmering, and secretive.

The fragrance is available as a 75 ml and a 200 ml Eau de Parfum.
gender: women. La Pausa Eau de Parfum was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge. The fragrance features Iris, Woody Notes, Green Notes and Powdery Notes

name: Bel Respiro Eau de Parfum
desc:
Bel Respiro Eau de Parfum, “an outdoor perfume,” is described as an illuminating display of an ideal spring with green grass and a light breeze. As a gentle and idyllic floral-green fragrance, it represents freshness and sophistication, bringing together dewy grass, crushed leaves, and aromas associated with the Garrigue (the scrubland of Southern France).

The fragrances are available as a 75 ml and a 200 ml Eau de Parfum.
gender: women and men. Bel Respiro Eau de Parfum was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge. The fragrance features Green Notes, Grass, Floral Notes, Leather, Galbanum and Rosemary

name: Coromandel Eau de Parfum
desc:
Coromandel Eau de Parfum, "a perfume of art," is described as a powerful and rich woody oriental. It is made of notes of frankincense, benzoin, patchouli, and amber, and is inspired by the exquisite Chinese lacquer screens that lined Mademoiselle Chanel’s apartments.

The fragrances are available as a 75 ml and a 200 ml Eau de Parfum.

name: N°18 Eau de Parfum
desc:
No. 18 Eau de Parfum, "a perfume of fine jewelry," is designed as a scent of rare and sparkling gems; glittering, fruity, and woody, and decorated with oriental accents. It reveals lively and syrupy fruity notes covered in ambrette seeds.

The fragrance is available as a 75 ml and a 200 ml Eau de Parfum.
gender: women. N°18 Eau de Parfum was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge. The fragrance features Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Fruity Notes, Woody Notes, Iris and Floral Notes

name: 31 Rue Cambon Eau de Parfum
desc:
31 Rue Cambon Eau de Parfum, “a perfume couture,” is described as a delightful, warm, and elegant chypre fragrance that reflects the epicenter of the universe of Mademoiselle Chanel. It is haute couture in a scent.

The fragrances are available as a 75 ml and a 200 ml Eau de Parfum.

name: N°22 Eau de Parfum
desc:
No. 22 Eau de Parfum, "a perfume of skin," is a powdery-floral-aldehyde creation with a sensual and seductive character. Sweet and refined tuberose is used as a "sign of femininity." The fragrance was originally made as a light version of the famous N°5.

The fragrance is available as a 75 ml and a 200 ml Eau de Parfum.

name: Poison Girl Eau De Toilette
desc:
Dior launched Poison Girl in January 2016 as the fragrance of a new generation of Poison. Its sweet and heady combination of bitter orange, Damask rose and rose from Grasse, almond, vanilla and tonka bean is announced by the slogan "I'm not a girl, I'm poison." A year later, in January 2017, its new edition comes out as Poison Girl Eau De Toilette.

Poison Girl Eau de Toilette is a refreshed version of the original, dedicated to the same "type of femininity ... freer, more daring and more virtual than ever." The new composition, which is also signed by Francois Demachy, is based on the "shock effect" of three aromatic aspects; there are refreshing frozen orange, warm roses from Grasse and sparkling neroli.

The signature bottle design, which was created for the original fragrance in 1985 by designer Véronique Monod, is also present in this edition. The fragrance will be available as a 30, 50 and 100 ml Eau de Toilette.

name: Side Effect
gender: women and men. Side Effect was launched in 2016. The fragrance features Rum, Tobacco, Cinnamon, Saffron, Sandalwood and Hedione

name: Dior Homme Sport 2017
desc:
The first version of Dior Homme Sport fragrance came out in 2008. The reformulation of Dior Homme Sport from 2012, made as a more elegant and powdery variation, is replaced by this new edition in February 2017. Dior Homme Sport "rediscovers itself" like a scent of "urban, sophisticated and sexy nonchalance," guided by the idea of a fast and dynamic lifestyle.

Dior's in-house perfumer Francois Demachy created all the previous versions of this fragrance. The new version is created with the addition of "extreme" fruits, "explosive" notes, spices, herbs and woods. Citrus accords of lemon, blood orange and grapefruit open the composition. The spicy heart includes notes of pink pepper and nutmeg, lying on the woody base of sandalwood and vetiver.

The bottle was also renovated with a softer color of liquid and a more "refined" packaging. The face of the advertising campaign is actor Robert Pattinson, and the motto is "Life is a Playground."

The fragrance is available as a 50, 75 and 125 ml Eau de Toilette.

name: Pour Monsieur Eau de Parfum
gender: men. Pour Monsieur Eau de Parfum was launched in 2016. The fragrance features Lemon, Vanilla, Lavender, Nutmeg and Vetiver

name: J'Adore In Joy
desc:
One of the pillars of the current perfume line from Dior, J`Adore, gets a new edition in the spring of 2017 called J`Adore In Joy. The fragrance is announced as the scent of joy, love for life, instant fun and the exclamation of spring. It is said to be a daring fruity- floral with a salty taste.

In-house perfumer Francois Demachy adds an unexpected and unusual touch of salt to the warm floral composition, inspired by the natural phenomenon and finest gourmet salt "Fleur de Sel". This salty accord in the top of the composition emphasizes the combination of white flowers that includes sambac jasmine, neroli, tuberose and ylang-ylang from Grasse. An accord of ripe peaches in the perfume’s base gives the whole composition a fruity touch.

J'adore In Joy comes in a renewed bottle with liquid gold-peach-colored sparkles that diffuse the light thanks to the convex bottom. The fragrance is available in bottles of 50 and 100 ml.

name: Sauvage Very Cool Spray
desc:
The house of Dior presented Sauvage in 2015 as a modern aromatic - fougere fragrance for men. Sauvage Very Cool Spray is a new variant of this fragrance, which comes out in the spring of 2017 as a refreshing reinterpretation of the original in a convenient packaging.

Made to emphasize the freshness of the composition, Sauvage Very Cool Spray is neither a derivative nor a légère variation of the original. Its composition is enriched with a dose of grapefruit in the top notes, which makes it different from the first edition and gives it extra freshness.

The spray is practical for continuous spraying even when the bottle is turned upside down, as well as suitable for travel (described as "nomadic") and eco-responsible. Dior Sauvage Very Cool Spray will be available as a 100 ml Eau de Toilette.

name: Eau Sauvage Parfum 2017
desc:
In April 2017, Dior launches a new edition of Eau Sauvage Parfum. Francois Demachy wanted to create a more rounded version that will be closer to their original signature, as well as to refresh its aromatic strength, emphasize the warmth and intensify the composition. Its citrus - woody - spicy structure, which combines an elegant freshness and warm accords, is allegedly "sunny" and exudes a bright naturalness.

The citrusy beginning of the composition blends sweet cedrat with San Carlo bergamot. After this fresh opening, delicate notes of lavender absolute come to play. The heart of the perfume contains Haitian vetiver, its woody character amplified and purified. Warm and intense notes of elemi from the Philippines end this creation in the base of the perfume.

The advertising campaign brings back unpublished images of actor Alain Delon while shooting the movie "La Piscine" from 1969, as an emblem of masculine beauty and French elegance. The fragrance is available as a 50 and 100 ml Eau de Parfum.

name: J'Adore Summer Fragrance
desc: J`Adore Summer Fragrance by Dior is a floral fruity fragrance for women. J`Adore Summer Fragrance was launched in 2004. The fragrance features Champaca flower, mandarin, crystallized orchid, jasmine, muguet, violet, Damascus plum, Amaranth Wood and blackberry musk. Summer limited edition.

name: Miss Dior Eau de Parfum (2017)
desc:
New Miss Dior Eau de Parfum edition comes out in September 2017, created by Dior perfumer Francois Demachy. The face of advertising campaign is actress Natalie Portman. The fragrance is advertised with slogans like "Miss Dior for love", "Dior for love" and "And what about you? What would you do for love?".

The composition is announced as an elegant floral, with dominant notes of roses, the Damask rose and the May rose from Grasse, to be precise. The rest of the composition consists of a fresh opening of lemon, mandarin and pink pepper and a sensual accord in the base that includes rosewood and patchouli.

It is available as a 50 and 100 ml Eau de Parfum.

name: Paper Soap
desc:
"Nostalgic scent led by cleanliness and creamy sweetness. From the scent of lavender and aldehydes cleanliness, the sweetness of the flowers of rose, jasmine, muguet spreads and eventually it is a nostalgic scent that opens the door of memories with a calm musk." - a note from the brand.

Paper Soap by J-Scent is a Floral Aldehyde fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Paper Soap was launched in 2017. The fragrance features aldehydes, lavender, rose, jasmine, lily-of-the-valley and musk.
gender: women and men. Paper Soap was launched in 2017. The fragrance features Aldehydes, Musk, Lily-of-the-Valley, Rose, Jasmine, Lavender and Geranium

name: Passage d'Enfer
desc: Passage d'Enfer by L Artisan Parfumeur is an Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. Passage d'Enfer was launched in 1999. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivia Giacobetti. The fragrance features lily, incense, woodsy notes and musk.
gender: women and men. Passage d'Enfer was launched in 1999. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivia Giacobetti. The fragrance features Incense, Lily, Woodsy Notes and Musk

name: Les Exclusifs de Chanel Beige
desc:
Chanel Beige was presented in 2008, when it joined the collection known as "Les Exclusifs." Beige includes aromas of hawthorn, freesia, frangipani, and honey accords.

The bottle is available as a 200 ml EDT.
gender: women. Les Exclusifs de Chanel Beige was launched in 2008. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge. The fragrance features Frangipani, Freesia, Honey and Hawthorn

name: Les Exclusifs de Chanel Sycomore
desc: Sycomore by Chanel is a woody floral musk fragrance for women. Sycomore is a new fragrance and it was introduced in 2008. The noses behind this fragrance are Jacques Polge and Christopher Sheldrake. The fragrance features vetiver, sandalwood, aldehydes, tobacco and violet.
gender: women and men. Les Exclusifs de Chanel Sycomore was launched in 2008. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge. The fragrance features Vetiver, Cypress, Tobacco, Juniper, Sandalwood, Aldehydes, Pink Pepper, Spicy Notes and Violet

name: Hawas for Him
desc: Hawas for Him blends cinnamon, bergamot, orange blossom, grey amber and sandalwood to create an aquatic scent designed to embody masculine strength and vigour. This fresh elegant woody perfume combines the premium Italian citrus and the fruity freshness of pear and pineapple. The heart of this modern fougere is based on aquatic elements combined with melon and violet. It is a mix of sandalwood, cedar wood, musk with generous ambergris. The fragrance is inflected with fresh marine aromatic notes that melt into amber woods. The fragrance captures the adventurous, exploratory and evocative spirit of the modern man. The contemporary notes of this chic fragrance come with an attitude to match. The clear grey bottle has a python wrapped around the stopper while a textured python on the pack captures the sensuality of the species with a flamboyance redolent of haute couture.

name: Kabuki
desc:
Composition of Kabuki includes notes of sugared grapefruit, litchi and sweet jasmine.

Kabuki is traditional Japanese theater which was born in Kyoto in the beginning of the 17th ct. All roles were played by women in the beginning, but they were not allowed to take part in spectacles later, since behaviour of men towards women became immoral. Art of dance and song, sometimes translated as Kabuki, became exclusively men\'s craft.
gender: women and men. The nose behind this fragrance is Margot Elena. The fragrance features Sugar, Litchi, Grapefruit and Jasmine

name: Cuir de Russie Eau de Parfum
desc:
Cuir de Russie Eau de Parfum, "an imperial perfume," is a sensual and intense oriental that aims to transfer the wild and dark scents of balsam, exotic jasmine, birch, tobacco, and woods in a scent. Mademoiselle Chanel met the Grand Duke Dimitri who introduced her to the later-to-be-famous Chanel perfumer Ernest Beaux, born and trained in Moscow. In 1924, she worked with him to create the original of this fragrance.

The fragrance is available as a 75 ml and a 200 ml Eau de Parfum.

name: Poison Girl Unexpected
desc:
At the beginning of 2018, the house of Dior launches Poison Girl Unexpected, the new flanker of Poison Girl fragrance that came out in January 2016 as the new Poison generation. The new edition is announced as surprisingly fresh and sparkling interpretation.

Poison Girl Unexpected is an edition with a large dose of ginger. The composition is a fresh, floral and spicy one. Ginger’s bitter freshness and tinglingness is mixed with blood orange accord at the top, leading to the signature part of the composition - Damask Rose in the heart and vanilla in the base.

Together with the new fragrance, Dior will present a new fromat and a way of applying perfumes – a 20 ml of Roller Pearl. Dior Poison Girl Unexpected is available as a 30, 50 and 100 ml Eau de Parfum.

name: Sauvage Eau de Parfum
desc:
In 2018, Dior introduces the new edition of Dior Sauvage, originally launched in 2015, in an Eau de Parfum interpretation. Dior‘s in-house perfumer François Demachy imagines the Eau de Parfum as revealing new facets of Sauvage. The composition with oriental and vanilla facets is described as enveloping, suave, mysterious and sensual.

he composition keeps some of the notes from the original, like bergamot, Sichuan pepper, lavender and ambroxan and enriches them with spices and warm, oriental tones of star anise, nutmeg and papua vanilla.

The new ad campaign also features actor Johnny Depp as the face. The fragrance is available as a 60 and a 100 ml Eau de Parfum.

name: Dior Homme Sport Very Cool Spray
desc:
Dior Homme Sport, from 2017, got its new version in the form of fresh Very Cool Spray packaging, seen for the first time with the Sauvage Very Cool Spray release. Guided by the idea of accelerated and dynamic lifestyle, new Dior Homme Sport Very Cool Spray offers slightly modified scent notes of the original adapted to the new way of application.

Perfumer François Demachy reduced the sharpness of Italian citron in the upper notes and left more room for the red orange, so the opening is more fruity than bitter. The heart contains aromatic notes on a woody base, with a Haitian vetiver accord.


The spray is practical, convenient for travel and an environmentally friendly product. Dior Homme Sport Very Cool Spray is available as a 100 ml Eau de Toilette Fraiche.
gender: men. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy. Top notes are Blood Orange, Citron, Grapefruit, Bergamot, Rosemary, Lavender and Pear; middle notes are Ginger, Pink Pepper, elemi and Nutmeg; base notes are Sandalwood, Haitian Vetiver, Cedar, Vanilla and Amberwood

name: Coco Mademoiselle Intense
desc:
"A new facet of the COCO MADEMOISELLE personality, amplified by an extreme dose of Patchouli and an Oriental accord that combines Tonka Bean and Vanilla from Madagascar. A powerful, deep, irresistible composition.

PATCHOULI: Extreme, luminous, deep, infusing the fragrance with voluptuousness.

THE AMBER ACCORD: Warm, soft, and feminine, wrapping the fragrance in sensuality."


Chanel Coco Mademoiselle Eau de Parfum Intense is available in 50 and 100 ml bottles.

name: Terra Bella
gender: women and men. Terra Bella was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy. The fragrance features Orange Blossom, Cypress and Myrtle

name: Purple Oud
desc: "Purple Oud expresses an Oriental dream as depicted in a vivid, warm painting. It's a sparkling oud that sees powerful wood combine with lively notes. Orange blends with fresh spices such as Pink Peppercorn and Saffron. This shimmering oud will seduce those who like the animal strength of this heady wood, albeit a polished, brightened version that plays out in the background." - FRANÇOIS DEMACHY, Dior Perfumer-Creator.
gender: women and men. Purple Oud was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy. The fragrance features Orange, Agarwood (Oud), Pink Pepper and Saffron

name: Santal Noir
gender: women and men. Santal Noir was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy

name: Rose Kabuki
desc: "I wanted to create a delicate rose swathed in powdery, cottony musks, bringing to mind the immaculate faces of traditional Japanese Kabuki theater. A rose that is pink at heart, but enveloped in a white that haloes its petals. Its caressing softness is pricked with vivid, dew-pearled greens." - FRANÇOIS DEMACHY, Dior Perfumer-Creator.
gender: women and men. Rose Kabuki was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy. The fragrance features Rose, Dew Drop and Musk

name: Lucky
gender: women and men. Lucky was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy. The fragrance features Lily-of-the-Valley, White Flowers and Ozonic notes

desc: This fragrance is dedicated to famous Gris Dior color and to Brand's 70th anniversary. Gris Dior, previously known as Gris Montaigne, has the same olfactory composition.
gender: women and men. Gris Dior was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy. The fragrance features Oakmoss, Rose, Patchouli, Bergamot, Cedar, Amber and Sandalwood

name: Happy Hour
desc: "I wanted to evoke the carefree age of youthful folly. The scent is sharply sweet like a cranberry. Sparkling, almost insolent, at its fresh floral heart are Jasmine and Ylang Ylang. It's the perfume of a lovable woman and has the taste of happiness." François Demachy Dior Perfumer-Creator.
gender: women and men. Happy Hour was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy. The fragrance features Cranberry, Ylang-Ylang and Jasmine
