Dior’s collection Les Creations de Monsieur Dior introduced in 2009 represents a review of vintage editions. The collection includes 5 perfumes – 5 classic fragrances favorized by many women worldwide.

Diorella, Dioressence, Diorissimo, Eau Fraiche Forever and Ever make the five fragrances of the Les Creations de Monsieur Dior collection, presented as timeless opus of Dior which resists time and new trends.

Romantic violet nuances announce the last fragrance of the Creations de Monsieur Dior Forever and Ever collection while insinuating Dior's timeless compositions which will be worn by next generations.

Forever and Ever was presented in 2002 as a sophisticated floral composition which leaves a mild, spicy trail in a base. A floral bouquet of freesia, jasmine, rose, pelargonium and almond blossom are refreshed with ivy and spiced with nutmeg, vanilla and musk.

The new version of Les Creations de Monsieur Dior Forever and Ever is available in a lovely glass flacon (50 and 100 ml EDT) with an accentuated floral light-motive of the composition. Pink nuances of the fragrance were inspired by rose-garden Dior Granville. Top notes of the perfume bloom with freesia flowers, a heart hides jasmine from India, while a base is enriched with intoxicating Bulgarian rose-garden.

name: Miss Dior Rose Essence
desc:
Miss Dior Rose Essence is the fruit of the 2021 harvest of May roses from the Domaine de Manon in Grasse.

Exclusive and historical partner of Dior in Grasse, the Domaine de Manon devotes for the first time its entire May rose harvest to distillation to obtain rosewater.

Rosewater sparkles at the heart of Miss Dior Rose Essence. It is a fresh and pleasant delicacy that is inspired by Grasse's best-kept secret: that of personal pleasure passed down from mother to daughter for generations. Round and sweet, rose water refreshes this composition marked by naturalness.

Miss Dior Rose Essence is the reunion between a surprising floral freshness and a sensuality of woody notes of vetiver, patchouli, and guaiac, dressed in comfortable musks. It is a perfume that leaves nature in its wake, the extraordinary sensation provided by an endless field of roses.

Miss Dior Rose Essence is available as a 100 ml Eau de Toilette, limited edition.

name: Firewater
desc:
"Let’s dance around a smoked-out beach bonfire, skin anointed with sticky citrus char.

Place reference: Corryvreckan Whirlpool, Isle of Jura

Impression: Black Tea, Juniper Berry, Nettle, Grapefruit, Beardtongue, Osmanthus Absolute, Ginger, Bracken & Larch

Fade: Birchwood, Sugar Kelp, Guaiacwood, Vetiver, Oakwood, Benzoin, Labdanum Absolute & Peat Accord"

(info provided by the brand)

name: Solution No.4
desc: Solution 4 is a fresh urban aroma contrasted by a warm woody and leathery base to recreate a world of comfort and fullness. A fragrance with a chic streetwear spirit where nature, symbolized by eucalyptus, lavender, and woods, takes possession of the city represented by black leather. This unisex fragrance also invites itself into your home for even more well-being and harmony.

name: Gabrielle Parfum
desc:
The Product

The most precious and sensual interpretation of GABRIELLE CHANEL. Striking from the first drop, it is worn directly on the skin to feel the full intensity of its floral power. In its square, thin-walled bottle, the fragrance seems to levitate. The box, the cover and the label are tinted with a deep gold. For the first time, CHANEL is presenting a bottle of Extrait topped with a spray that allows precise perfuming for an intensely feminine trail.

The Composition

Perfume, often called Extrait, expresses the quintessence of CHANEL Parfumeur's know-how. GABRIELLE CHANEL PARFUM is an intense and multi-faceted floral composition, in which jasmine, ylang-ylang, orange blossom and tuberose from Grasse unfold in turn. Considered the most bewitching of all flowers, Grasse tuberose is obtained by a unique extraction process that captures the freshness of its petals. Its floral heart, surrounded by the comfort of sandalwood and vanilla absolute, makes it a particularly sensual composition.
For Olivier Polge, Perfumer-Creator of Maison CHANEL, “GABRIELLE CHANEL PARFUM is a floral jewel. The most precious expression of GABRIELLE CHANEL, which will leave no one indifferent, like the woman who wears it”.

The Inspiration

“I chose what I wanted to be and I am”. (Gabrielle Chanel)
Before being the name of a perfume, Gabrielle is the first name of a woman: Coco Chanel. A woman who made history by changing the rules. GABRIELLE CHANEL is the fragrance of a free and passionate woman, who asserts herself and who decides her destiny.

The Art of Perfume

The GABRIELLE CHANEL PARFUM bottle was designed with a vaporizer for an intensely feminine fragrance. A precise gesture that targets the pulse points: behind the ear, the tip of the neckline and in the hollow of the wrist.
gender: women. Gabrielle Parfum was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Polge. The fragrance features Tuberose, Orange Blossom, Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang, Vanilla Absolute and Sandalwood

name: Miss Dior Bobby Limited Edition
desc:
Dior recreates the iconic dog-shaped Bobby perfume bottle, tagged "J’appartiens à Miss Dior" ("I belong to Miss Dior"), in the new limited edition of Miss Dior Eau de Parfum from July 2022.

This second Bobby edition contains floral accords that sees the colourful profusion of the millefiori where an elegant rose blossoms, powdered with noble iris note and heightened by peony note.

This limited edition EDP will be available exclusively at Dior Beauty boutiques. Available in a 90 ml bottle.

name: J'adore Parfum d'Eau
desc:
Dior launches J'adore Parfum d'Eau, a new fragrance from the J'Adore Dior collection. With this new edition, Dior reinvents J'adore in a formula without alcohol. This is a "true ode to the white flowers of J'adore, in a fresh and spontaneous interpretation."

J'adore Parfum d'Eau brings a fresh floral scent; it represents an abundance of flowers, sensual and spontaneous. Dior says that the fragrance of immediate floral freshness replaces the traditional top-heart-base composition. Neroli from Vallauris gives its freshness to the composition, while the sunny notes of Arabian jasmine mingle with the velvety notes of Chinese magnolia. There are also carnal rose and fresh honeysuckle.

The signature J'adore amphora-shaped bottle is reinvented with an opalescent white glass that symbolizes the velvety caress of flower petals.

Available in bottles of 50 and 100 ml Eau de Parfum.
gender: women. J'adore Parfum d'Eau was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy. The fragrance features Jasmine Sambac, Green Notes, Magnolia, Honeysuckle, Neroli and Rose

name: Khamrah
desc: Lattafa Khamrah is a luxurious oriental-spicy unisex perfume that combines precious spices, the warmth of woody notes and the softness of vanilla. The fragrance is released by the Arab luxury perfume brand Lattafa Perfumes and comes in a luxurious crystal bottle. The top accord of Khamrah is the citrusy freshness of bergamot framed by the warm, velvety spice of cinnamon and refined clary sage. The heart of the perfume resonates with the delightful creamy smell of praline, melting in a fragrant haze of sweet fruity notes and tuberose floral nuances. Whereas the base of Lattafa Khamrah delivers a sumptuous aromatic trail that blends the sensual sweetness of vanilla with spicy precious woods, sweet smoky oud, smoky aromatic myrrh, spicy tonka bean and vanilla resinous benzoin, shimmering softly in the beams. refined amber.

name: Sycomore Parfum
gender: women and men. Sycomore Parfum was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Polge. The fragrance features Vetiver, Cedar, Iris, Vanilla and Leather

name: Vibrato
desc:
Bask in the entrancing warmth of a perfect aromatic vibrato. A classy, sparkling fragrance that leads with sweet floral top notes of Magnolia and Jasmine with an uplifting, citrusy touch of Bergamot and Grapefruit. A burst of Ginger and Powdery notes balanced with a dewy and fresh herbal accent to add a smooth and mellow aroma. The charming and warm base made of a semi-spicy and woody mix of Cedarwood, Oriental, Musk, Patchouli, and Orris notes creates a complex and vivid scent that is also quite subtle.

Top Notes: Jasmine, Bergamot, Grapefruit Magnolia
Heart Notes: Herbal, Ginger, Powdery
Base Notes: Cedarwood, Oriental, Musk, Patchouli, Orris

name: Jasmin Elixir Precieux
desc:
"Continue your experience of La Collection Privée Christian Dior's precious elixirs by discovering the other creations: Patchouli, Ambre, Musc, Rose and Oud.

Jasmin Élixir Précieux is an invitation to layer scents and celebrate an age-old fragrance ritual. It gives you the possibility to combine this elixir signature with a La Collection Privée Christian Dior fragrance to enrich and facet its trail. It is a way to experience perfuming with a rare intensity by creating your own personal fragrance mark that can be endlessly adapted.

This perfume extract, formulated with carefully selected noble raw materials, illustrates the expertise of the Dior perfumer. Intensely floral, intriguing and authentic, its trail concentrated in jasmine upholds and enriches the fresh lily-of-the-valley bouquet of Lucky: an olfactory union that exalts an exceptional moment created by La Collection Privée Christian Dior.

The luxurious glass bottle that houses the fragrance oil, inspired by the Dior legacy, is the product of cutting-edge expertise."

Available as a 3 ml erfume oil.
gender: women and men. Jasmin Elixir Precieux was launched in 2022. The fragrance features Jasmine and Lily-of-the-Valley

name: Patchouli Elixir Precieux
desc:
"Patchouli Élixir Précieux unfurls all the intensity of patchouli essence in an exceptional extract composed by La Collection Privée Christian Dior. Crafted with noble raw materials, rigorously selected in line with the Dior expertise, this fragrance oil is highly concentrated.

The Patchouli precious elixir can be worn alone, in an approach akin to an age-old perfuming ritual: a few drops of the fragrance oil suffice, deposited on pulse points (neck, wrists and décolleté). For an olfactory experience that plays with contrasts, Patchouli Élixir Précieux can also be worn with the Gris Dior fragrance by La Collection Privée Christian Dior to facet its citrusy and floral notes.

The precious fragrance oil is sealed in a luxurious glass bottle crafted with expert and precision savoir-faire. Embark on exceptional discoveries with the other precious elixir creations by La Collection Privée Christian Dior: Jasmin, Rose, Musc and Ambre."

Available as a 3 ml erfume oil.
gender: women and men. Patchouli Elixir Precieux was launched in 2022. The fragrance features Patchouli

name: Minnie Mouse The Fragrance
desc:
An everlasting sweetheart of the iconic Mickey Mouse, Minnie is sweet in nature, fun-loving, and cheerful. The endearing bond between Mickey and Minnie is heartwarming and widely recognized as two of the most beloved characters of all time.

Just like its pairing, this delightful and sweet fragrance of Minnie Mouse will instantly transport you to the excitement of entering the Magical World of Disney and all its delectable treats. This charming scent will bring joyful smiles and happiness to those around you with delicious notes such as marshmallows, raspberries, caramel, coconut, and vanilla.

Dynamically presented in a playful Minnie Bow silhouette design cap and embellished with diamond-cut Swarovski crystals, a hallmark of innovation and elegance. The bottle is crafted from the finest French glass and hand-painted in a mesmerizing ombre effect.

name: Vanilla Royale Sugared Patchouli | 64 Eau De Parfum Intense
desc:
“Calling all vanilla lovers!! Get ready for Vanilla | 28’s boujee big sister, something deeper, more intense, sexy, and RICH AF --- Vanilla Royale! It’s no secret that I am a vanilla lover and OBSESSED with gourmand fragrances. I am addicted to the sweet and captivating qualities this note brings to a juice, and I’ve always wanted to create a more decadent and intense version.” – Mona Kattan

With an enhanced blend of exotic florals, rich spices, and dark, decadent notes, the eleventh fragrance in the Kayali collection, Vanilla Royale Sugared Patchouli | 64 unites contrasting textures: gourmand indulgence with rich sensuality for an intense new level of sophistication. As a new member of the Kayali vanilla family, this complex explosion of sweet vanilla mixed with sugared patchouli will be the crown jewel in every vanilla lovers collection.

Collaborating once again with senior perfumer Gabriela Chelariu from famed perfume house Firmenich and the nose behind Vanilla | 28, Mona Kattan has taken her love for gourmands one step further.

“The vanilla note is always a part of our Kayali DNA, but for this scent, I really wanted to show another side to this delicious ingredient, make it something incredibly over-the-top, and to make everyone feel like the royal version of themselves!”

"For the opening of Vanilla Royale Sugared Patchouli | 64, the elegant and warm vanilla orchid and creamy jasmine unite with golden rum for an intoxicating intensity. In the heart of the fragrance, vanilla infusion, vanilla surabsolute, and crème brulée create an overload of sweet, gourmand sensations while nuances of almond, tobacco, and caramel from the tonka bean bring an intense level of irresistibility. Powerful yet delicate, the spicy rose bouquet, along with smoky leather, creates an intriguing signature that is raw and velvety yet distinctively refined. Earthy with woody and camphorous facets, sugared patchouli glistens with sparkling sweetness while toasted tones of brown sugar further enhance the dark, decadent richness. The amber brings glowing intrigue to the exotic royal oud woven throughout the fragrance to enhance the dry down further. Finally, a tender trace of creamy musk creates a scent uniquely contrasted by soft sensuality and deep, luxurious richness."

Top Notes: Vanilla Orchid, Creamy Jasmine, Golden Rum
Middle Notes: Vanilla Infusion, Vanilla Surabsolute, Tonka Bean Accord, Spicy Rose Bouquet, Smoky Leather, Crème Brulée
Base Notes: Sugared Patchouli, Musk, Brown Sugar, Oriental, Royal Oud

The latest fragrance, Vanilla Royale Sugared Patchouli | 64 arrives in the same designed flacon as the previous editions of Kayali Fragrance, now in a golden bottle and jeweled cap.

The limited-edition KAYALI Vanilla Royale Sugared Patchouli | 64 Eau de Parfum Intense will be available to shop in 100ml, 50ml, 10ml deluxe bottle, and 10ml travel spray.

name: Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Intense
gender: men. Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Intense was launched in 2023. Valentino Uomo Born In Roma Intense was created by Antoine Maisondieu and Guillaume Flavigny. Top note is Vanilla; middle note is Lavender; base note is Vetiver

name: Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet (2023)
desc:
"Rediscover the trail of Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet through a fragrant declaration of love narrated by Natalie Portman, where the freshness of rose and peony notes mingle with the caress of a white musk veil.

Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet Eau de Toilette has been composed like a floral embrace, both lively and tender. It is a faceted and spontaneous bouquet of newly blossomed flowers. Its contrasting trail opens with the intensity of the feeling of love at sight, conveyed in the lively notes of sweet pea and bergamot.

A duo of Damascus rose and peony notes then unfurls with nobleness, like a passionate and radiant emotion. A soft, light accord of white musks rounds off the bouquet of this fragrance that tells the story of love.

The Miss Dior Blooming Bouquet fragrance is housed in a bottle with an elevated identity: the Miss Dior bow, woven with multicolored Lurex threads for a "Millefiori" effect, gives the fragrance an added couture detail. This ingenious jacquard bow, inspired by a bouquet of a thousand colored flowers, was crafted in the guarded workshops of one of the most renowned French ribbon-makers: Maison Faure, founded in 1864."

Available as 30, 50, 100, and 150ml EDT.

name: Pure Poison Elixir
desc: This mesmerizing and magical fragrance achieved the status of Elixir. Floral and intoxicating, Pure Poison became warmer, softer and gentler. Its floral bouquet is embellished by powdery, sweet, spicy and almond nuances. A spray-bulb bottle echoes the retro style glamour. The opening is sparkling and incisive, thanks to petitgrain and green mandarin orange followed by an intoxicating note of orange blossom and Sambac jasmine, with their gently sweet aromas. The ending is powdery and rich due to sandalwood, bitter-sweet almond, vanilla and cocoa bean absolute. Perfume was created in 2006. Read more about Dior Pure Poison from 2004.

name: Coco Mademoiselle Hair Mist (2023)
desc: A travel-friendly gesture that subtly scents hair with the most airy, fresh and delicate notes of COCO MADEMOISELLE. Sensual patchouli and vetiver are illuminated by notes of vibrant orange as well as feminine jasmine and rose. Enriched with a non-drying emollient, the formula smooths strands without weighing them down. An ideal way to revive the trail of the ambery-fresh composition throughout the day.

name: Chance Eau Tendre
desc:
Chanel is presenting a new flanker of their popular fragrance Chance which arrives on the market on April 2nd 2010. The romantic and pink new version, Chance Eau Tendre, is announced as a floral-fruity interpretation of Chance EDP.

Face of advertising campaign is Sigrid Agren, and photographer is Jean-Paul Goude. The flacon is the same as its antecedent, but it is characterized by pink fluid this time. The fragrance will be available as 50 and 100ml.

name: Le Male Elixir
desc:
Welcome on board!
The new sailor Le Male Elixir will induce burning cravings and drive your senses crazy. Burning desire spreads with the irresistible notes of fresh lavender, warming tonka bean, and gentle benzoin. With a gilded torso, this fiery novelty from Jean Paul Gaultier embodies radiant power and seductive charisma.
It is finished! You melt away with burning desire.

This intense fragrance ignites the fire of the senses on his upper body and gives the soft skin a burning sensuality. After a refreshing breeze of mint, the tide rises to addiction, becoming a glowing elixir. In this breath of fresh air, dashing lavender quickly takes on lusty proportions, enhanced by the balsamic richness of benzoin with syrupy vanilla accents. The tonka bean trumps with its warm and sweet tones between honey and tobacco. The time has come: You jump!

Radiant at first sight, glowing with masculinity, more fiery than ever. The torso is bursting with muscles, the skin is bathed in copper color by the sinking sun. What a Gaultier body... what accomplished style. Finely chiseled grooves stand out on its muscles dipped in gold and merge with the amber stripes of the sailor shirt, which plays with transparency effects in a highly sexy way.

Available as 75ml and 125ml Parfum.

name: Dioriviera
desc: DIORIVIERA is designed to convey modern and romantic impressions inspired by the rose garden near Château Noire, located in the South of France. Elegantly fruity green and floral, the fragrance combines the smells of rose, fig, and green notes with the slight warmness of a nice, sunny day. The fruitiness comes from both roses and figs.
gender: women and men. Dioriviera was launched in 2023. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance features Fig, Green Notes and Rose

name: Miss Dior Cherie Eau De Toilette 2010
desc:
A new olfactive interpretation of Miss Dior Cherie is arriving on the market in March 2010. This fresh and elegant floral-chypre successor aims at younger women who enjoy freedom and independence.

Transparent notes of freesia and lily of the valley start this spring, feminine composition which lines up accords of jasmine, orange blossom and tuberose. Top notes of Miss Dior Cherie Eau de Toilette 2010 are enriched with pleasant and almost fruity accents which lead us into a heart with charming popcorns, followed with pralines and vanilla.

A base is certainly leaving a clear chypre effect and a dose of elegance with patchouli accords. The fragrance is available as 50 and 100 ml EDT, shaped just like Miss Dior Cherie EDP edition from 2005. Liquid of the new EDT version is gentle pink. Tim Walker`s advertising campaign features a spring garden with roses in bloom.

name: Cruise Collection - Escale a Portofino Limited Edition
desc:
In limited edition, the Art Deco bottle of Escale à Portofino Eau de Toilette nestles in a case enhanced with a sublime blue-grey decoration: a pattern inspired by toile de Jouy, one of the emblematic codes of the Maison. A summer perfume with an identity intimately linked to that of the Riviera, Escale à Portofino unfolds a trail characterized by notes of luminous Mediterranean essences, such as those of bergamot from Calabria, petitgrain from Sicily or even citron from Italy. The composition also includes Citrus Essence, Bitter Almond Essence, Orange Blossom Essence.

Available as 100ml Eau de Toilette in limited numbers.
gender: women and men. Cruise Collection - Escale a Portofino Limited Edition was launched in 2023. The fragrance features Citron, Calabrian bergamot, Petitgrain, Orange Blossom and Bitter Almond

name: Chance Eau Fraiche Eau de Parfum
Vampire Blood
gender: women and men. Vampire Blood was launched in 2023. The fragrance features Red Berries, Plum and Jasmine

name: MYSLF Eau de Parfum
desc:
“MYSLF is the expression of the man you are, with all of your emotions and nuances.

“A twist of the traditional woody fragrance family with flowers. A statement of modern masculinity to celebrate your true self.”

The expression of the man you are, with all your nuances. A statement of modern masculinity, embracing all his facets and emotions.

The first YSL BEAUTY woody floral for a contrasted trail of modernity.

At first, a fresh & vibrant accord made of bergamot heart from Calabria and vert de bergamot.
At heart, a raw & beating orange blossom absolute heart from Tunisia crafted for YSL beauty.
At last, a sensual & textured woods accord made of Indonesian patchouli heart and Ambrofix™.

A YSL silhouette in a bottle. Sleek. Fluid.
A black lacquered monolith in nuances where you can see yourself. At its heart, embedded in the glass, is the iconic YSL Cassandre logotype.

My scent, MYSLF.

Available as 40ml, 60ml 100ml Eau de Parfum. Refil bottle is available in size of 150ml Eau de Parfum.
gender: men. MYSLF Eau de Parfum was launched in 2023. MYSLF Eau de Parfum was created by Christophe Raynaud, Antoine Maisondieu and Daniela Andrier. Top notes are Calabrian bergamot and Bergamot; middle note is Tunisian Orange Blossom; base notes are Ambrofix™ and Patchouli

name: Althaïr
desc:
Parfums de Marly launches Althaïr, a masculine fragrance that pays homage to French haute parfumerie and the woody-vanilla-amber fragrance family.

This modern tribute features high-quality Bourbon vanilla blended with citrus, spices, and noble woods for a balance of warmth and freshness. Created collaboratively by Julien Sprecher and perfumers Hamid Merati-Kashani and Ilias Ermenidis, Althaïr boasts a captivating contrast between traditional and disruptive notes, delivering distinct opulence.

Top Notes: Orange Blossom Absolute, Bergamot From Italy, Cinnamon From Ceylon, Cardamom From Guatemala Heart: Bourbon Vanilla From Madagascar, Elemi From The Philippines
Base: Ambrox, Guaiac Wood Praline, Musk

Encased in an opaque, warm-toned brown bottle, the fragrance's imagery invites a multisensory experience.
gender: men. Althaïr was launched in 2023. Althaïr was created by Hamid Merati-Kashani and Ilias Ermenidis. Top notes are Cinnamon, Orange Blossom, Cardamom and Bergamot; middle notes are Bourbon Vanilla and elemi; base notes are Praline, Musk, Ambroxan, Tonka, Guaiac Wood and Candied Almond

name: J'adore L'Or (2023)
desc:
All the gold of J'adore in an essential, pure concentrate. For L'Or de J'adore, the new J'adore perfume, Perfume Creative Director for Parfums Dior Francis Kurkdjian, showcases the beauty of the J'adore flowers by heightening their nuances and accentuating their colors.

J'adore l'Or is a full and voluptuous perfume essence by Francis Kurkdjian for Dior that masterfully balances notes of orange blossom, jasmine grandiflorum and centifolia rose absolutes. Blossoming in their full glory, powerful and sensual, these flowers are the true gold of J'adore.

The iconic J’adore necklace has been redesigned to reflect the warmth of the scent, transformed into an organic and flowing precious metal, enveloping the J'adore l'Or bottle in an elegant embrace.

"I wanted to move from the aura of J'adore to the gold of J'adore. To its olfactory quintessence. I wanted to give this floral signature accents of purity by exaggerating the contours of the flowers, to bring out all their nuances and define a new texture, like enveloping liquid gold. A new, instantly attractive sensuality."—Francis Kurkdjian, Director of Dior Fragrance Creation

Available in 50ml bottles.
gender: women. J'adore L'Or (2023) was launched in 2023. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance features Jasmine, Orange Blossom, Violet, Lily of the Valley and Rose

name: Eau de Cologne aux Fleurs Fraîches
gender: women and men. Eau de Cologne aux Fleurs Fraîches was launched during the 1950's. The nose behind this fragrance is Edmond Roudnitska. Top notes are Lemon and Lemon Verbena; middle notes are Jasmine, Rose Water and Lily of the Valley; base note is Oakmoss

name: Cristalle Eau Verte Eau de Parfum
gender: women. Cristalle Eau Verte Eau de Parfum was launched in 2023. The fragrance features Citruses, Green Notes, Jasmine and Magnolia

gender: women. Chanel N°19 Eau de Toilette (2023) was launched in 2023. The fragrance features Green Notes, Iris Pallida, Galbanum, Powdery Notes and Woody Notes

name: Cruise Collection Escale Aux Marquises
gender: women. Cruise Collection Escale Aux Marquises was launched in 2010. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy. The fragrance features Blood Orange, Ginger, Pink Pepper, Tiare Flower, Amalfi Lemon, Cardamom, Nutmeg, Pepper, Clove, Coriander, Elemi resin, Benzoin and Cinnamon

name: Narcotic Delight
desc:
"A Sensual Shot of Provocation. It set its sights on the erogenous VANILLA BEAN, electrified by PINK PEPPER, drenched in a draught of COGNAC, before finally succumbing to the intoxicating swirls of a cigar. A cheeky twist of plump and juicy CHERRY celebrates the indulgence of a polished proposition."

Available as 90ml EDP.

name: Miss Dior Parfum (2024)
gender: women. Miss Dior Parfum (2024) was launched in 2024. Miss Dior Parfum (2024) was created by Francis Kurkdjian and François Demachy. Top notes are Apricot, Peach and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Wild Strawberry, Floral Notes and Jasmine; base notes are Patchouli, Amberwood, Amber, Moss and Atlas Cedar

name: Cupid's Kiss
desc:
Inspiration
Love can come in many forms, whether that be friendship, familial or romantic love. Whichever form of love we consider, one thing is certain; it is complicated. This complexity ismirrored in the highly detailed and nuanced facets found in the fragrance, Cupid’s Kiss. From the uplifting delicacy of the pink pepper beginning, to the smooth comfort of the orris heart, through to the sophisticated suede elements in the base, one thing is sure: Cupid’s Kiss is a fragrance befitting that most timeless of human endeavours, love.

name: Perseus
desc:
A revitalizing, citrus-infused formulation with enlivening properties for both the physique and the psyche. A modern interpretation of grapefruit intertwined with fruity accents and vetiver to enhance vitality. The citrus essence harmonizes with the sophistication and vigor of a woody undertone, yielding a nuanced and juxtaposed sense of freshness.

The effervescence of grapefruit, juxtaposed with sophisticated woody nuances. Perseus enthralls the senses with its unparalleled luminosity. The invigorating initial impressions of grapefruit and bergamot reveal an elegant core of vetiver, while base notes of ambergris and dry woods provide a lasting resonance.

name: Comète
desc:
Olivier Polge asserts: "At the beginning of each creation, an element of inspiration is necessary and, in COMÈTE, the starting point was the idea of stardust. The comet is a strong symbol for CHANEL, and I am thinking in particular of the Comète pendant from the 1932 high jewelry collection. "When worn open and placed directly on the skin, it evokes the enveloping effect of a perfume on the skin".

With intensely floral and luminous notes, COMÈTE explores a new olfactory identity in the LES EXCLUSIFS DE CHANEL collection. Rich, elegant, and complex in nature, the Eau de Parfum is infused with the refreshing aroma of cherry blossoms, and this touch of brightness and purity transforms into a halo with notes of heliotrope blending with iris extract and musk harmony. This captivating fragrance, which envelops the skin in a mysterious charm, pays homage to its unique personality.

COMÈTE is a trail of stardust and a celestial jewel that chooses its own path and never deviates from it, reflecting Gabrielle Chanel. It is a halo of light, spreading a force of optimism for those who are convinced that the planets will align with their lucky star.

More unique and valuable than any other collection, the LES EXCLUSIFS DE CHANEL collection is embodied in a bottle with excellent and simple design, focusing all attention on the fragrance. COMÈTE is packaged in a sleek and timeless glass bottle with a black cap signed with the brand's monogram. Its box brings simplicity to the level of luxury and sophistication, taking the form of an elegant white jewelry box with a black trim.

Resembling a heritage seal, this delicate two-tone aesthetic accompanies the launch of COMÈTE, a special limited edition: an embossed representation of the legendary Comète necklace, created in 1932, seductively embracing all four sides of the box. In a final tribute to the brilliance of diamonds and stardust, the Double C logo on top of the box is highlighted with silver ink.

name: Bleu de Chanel Parfum
desc:
BLEU DE CHANEL represents the colour of freedom. A fragrance unveiling three nuances of its temperament in three interpretations: Eau de Toilette from 2010, Eau de Parfum from 2014 and Parfum from 2018.

"The most intense of the BLEU DE CHANEL fragrances. Powerful and refined, BLEU DE CHANEL Parfum for men reveals the essence of determination.An aromatic freshness opens, lingering on the warm, addictive fullness of Cedar and Sandalwood from New Caledonia that sweeps throughout the intense, woody fragrance."

It is available in bottles of 50 and 100 ml.

name: Drunk Maple
desc:
HEAD - Pink Pepper Jungle Essence, Davana Essential Oil, Rum Pure Jungle Essence
HEART - Coffee Resinoid, Maple Syrup, Soft Suede
BASE - Vanilla, Sandalwood, Benzoin Resinoid, Orcanox

name: Diorissimo (2024)
desc: "The House of Dior celebrates May 1st with a re-release of its iconic Diorissimo bottle, originally designed by Christian Dior in 1956. This cherished tradition pays homage to lily-of-the-valley, Christian Dior's lucky flower and the emblem of warm days."
gender: women. Diorissimo (2024) was launched in 2024. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. The fragrance features Lily of the Valley, Carnation, Jasmine and Rose

name: Philosia
desc: Philosia by Korres is inspired by the enchanting play of light and shadow under the trees, inviting one to slow down, breathe deeply, and appreciate the surrounding beauty. This fragrance is suitable for vegans.

name: If You Musk
gender: women. If You Musk was launched in 2024. The fragrance features Musk, Iris and Pink Pepper

name: Gardénia Eau de Parfum
desc:
Gardenia Eau de Parfum, "an imaginary creation," is an intense and opulent floral fragrance of creamy gardenia. It is described as a feminine fragrance that carries the blinding light of summer. Mademoiselle Chanel liked white flowers, as her emblem was camellia. Since it has no scent, gardenia is chosen as the next best thing.

The fragrance is available as a 75 ml and a 200 ml Eau de Parfum.

name: N°5 L’EAU – Limited Edition
desc:
CHANEL N°5 is a far-reaching mosaic that transcends passing time and retains the ethereal lightness of possibility in its fragrance trail. It is a promise made once before in 2016, when N°5 L’EAU was born, the iconic, newly enchanting fragrance, with floral freshness and unprecedented spirit. An active source of energy; light and transparent, but with sufficient gravitas to drop anchor and stay in the moment. It is an impulsive radiant drop whose dazzling citrus rays soar skywards, elevated by aldehydes. Then comes a floral swirl of jasmine, rose, and ylang-ylang, and then finally, dynamic vetiver and cedar.

A fragrance as addictive as a life line, simple in its sophistication, and capable of making the wildest dreams reality. A fluid and vigorous drop that goes against the flow, and houses every emotion in the world.

With it, we can be everything and its opposite: carefree, joyful, spiritual, mysterious, brave, wishful, and kind… This floral fragrance can fulfill current needs and release the emotions needed to live an instant in a few seconds, at a moment’s notice. It is an olfactory garment suitable for every occasion and every emotion. It is always ready, so you can be who you want when you want. Bravely, and with total freedom." - says Chanel.

The Drop bottle contains 1.7 FL. OZ. (50ml).

name: 214 Legno di Pepe
desc: LabSolue presents its olfactory celebration of Legno di Pepe (Pepper Wood). One of the first spices to arrive in Europe, pepper was once as valuable as gold. The Pepper Tree in its totality and complexity is LabSolue's source of inspiration, glorifying its aromatic and rich scent. The fragrance transitions from a dark and vibrant spice to warm and enveloping woods, characterized by intriguing Black Pepper Absolute, intertwined with sensual Benzoin Absolute and creamy Sandalwood Absolute. In 2023, Accademia del Profumo awarded LabSolue 214 Legno di Pepe as the Best Independent Artistic Brand Perfume and Best Home Fragrance.
gender: women and men. 214 Legno di Pepe was launched in 2023. The nose behind this fragrance is Pierre-Constantin Guéros. The fragrance features Black Pepper, Guaiac Wood, Benzoin and Sandalwood

name: Gabrielle L'Eau
desc:
GABRIELLE CHANEL L'EAU is a fresh floral composition, tinged with sparkling and fruity notes which brings new radiance to the radiance of the GABRIELLE line.

GABRIELLE CHANEL L'EAU is a floral composition, fresh and fruity, created around four flowers: jasmine, exotic and intense, ylang-ylang, with fruity and bright notes, orange blossom, fresh and sparkling, and tuberose from Grasse, creamy and intensely feminine. Considered the most captivating of all flowers, Grasse tuberose is reworked in a new harmony to accentuate its green and vegetal facets. The floral heart of GABRIELLE CHANEL L’EAU is illuminated by sparkling notes with accents of red fruits.

name: Le Sel d’Issey
desc:
Le Sel d’Issey by Issey Miyake is a woody aromatic fragrance that encapsulates the essence of a salt-sprayed voyage.

"Marine meets woody: the contrast of the elements gives birth to Le Sel d’Issey, a revitalizing fragrance born between the Ocean and the earth in a tribute to the salt of life."
gender: men. This is a new fragrance

name: Allure Homme Sport Superleggera
desc:
Allure Homme Sport Superleggera by Chanel is a limited-edition fragrance inspired by the Italian concept of superleggera, which emphasizes lightness and power. This scent is a rethinking of the classic Allure Homme Sport, featuring a lighter mix of woods, less amber, and an 'engine' of patchouli.

The “Superleggera” means “super light” in Italian, and was a nod to the innovative construction technique used by Carrozzeria Touring of Milan. This technique involved wrapping a lightweight aluminum body over a steel frame, resulting in both very light and structurally sound construction of a car.

name: Sauvage Eau Forte
desc:
Sauvage Eau Forte by Dior is a fresh and spicy fougère fragrance. This innovative scent features an alcohol-free formula, blending cold spices, bleached lavender, and musky woods. The fragrance is inspired by the symbolic power of water, creating a highly concentrated and milky-colored eau.

"The emblematic freshness of Sauvage intensified and extended by the power of water. A striking blend of cold spices and blanched lavender, deepened by the strength of musky woods in an exclusive water-based formula."

Available in bottles of 60 and 100 ml.

name: Rouge Trafalgar Esprit De Parfum
desc: Dior Rouge Trafalgar Esprit De Parfum is a new fragrance for women and men launched in 2024. Rouge Trafalgar Esprit de Parfum boasts a delicate, scarlet red shade, more intense and dense than ever, portraying a ripe, crisp cherry. The new Esprit de Parfum is darker and deeper due to the use of powerful notes like fiery pink pepper, the delicate yet opulent Turkish and Bulgarian roses, eventuating with a luscious blend of irresistibly delectable red fruits.

name: Gris Dior Esprit De Parfum
desc: Gris Dior Esprit De Parfum is a new fragrance for women and men launched in 2024. This unisex scent is characterized by its chypre vibes, unveiling a stronger character with opulent Atlas cedar, dry Indonesian patchouli, and creamy amber. The floral elements are intensified with seductive violet accord and fragrant Bulgarian rose.

name: Oud Ispahan Esprit De Parfum
desc: Dior Oud Ispahan Esprit De Parfum is a new fragrance for women and men launched in 2024. This wild interpretation of the original creation combines an enticing blend of woods and spices. The spicy duo of clove and cumin blend perfectly with a honeyed rose accord along with opulent oud, weaving a rich tapestry of colors that are powerful yet soft altogether.

name: Ambre Nuit Esprit De Parfum
desc: Dior Ambre Nuit Esprit De Parfum is a new fragrance for women and men launched in 2024. This scent is an invitation to journey into the dark, where musk seamlessly blends with spices like cinnamon and cardamom. Accompanied by a light amber accord, it leaves an enchanting scent trail that wraps the wearer in its allure.

name: Lucky Esprit De Parfum
desc: Dior Lucky Esprit De Parfum is a new fragrance for women and men launched in 2024. Lucky Esprit de Parfum draws inspiration from Christian Dior’s lucky star. An ode to the lily of the valley of the original creation. The sophisticated floral bouquet is further amplified by a woody leathery accord that braces a powerful scent trail.

name: Hypnotic Poison Eau Sensuelle
desc:
Dior is presenting new composition, Hypnotic Poison Eau Sensuelle, which gives a whole new magic of aromas.

Velvety soft petals of vanilla orchid surrounded with fruity aromas revive the scent of vanilla and add a lively frame which is not complete without Damascus rose. Instead of Sambac jasmine, Demachy includes ylang-ylang extract, while orange blossom absolute adds a full and gorgeous sensual note. To create impression of tasty fruit notes, this composition uses tuberose and vanilla, while green leaves and stem carry the scent of freshness. A base of Hypnotic Poison Eau Sensuelle incorporates creamy trace of sandalwood and musk, which are as harmonious as a woman's siluette. The new seductive fragrance by Dior - Hypnotic Poison Eau Sensuelle is available as 50 and 100 ml, as well as 100 ml spray deodorant from September 2010.

name: Bottled Absolu
desc: BOSS Bottled Absolu is a bold Eau de Parfum featuring an irresistible roasted signature. This woody-leathery scent is crafted by Annick Menardo in collaboration with Suzy Le Helley. It opens with a textured Leather accord harmonized with invigorating Incense essence. At the heart, Patchouli essence and Myrrh absolute elevate the scent, while warm Cedarwood and fruity Davana essences at the base leave a lasting trail.

name: Amber Oud Aqua Dubai
desc:
Dive into the refreshing temptation of the Arabian Sea with Haramain Amber Oud Aqua Dubai—a fragrance that captures the essence of Dubai's coastal charm. At the forefront, bergamot, green notes, and mandarin orange dance like sunlight on the water, evoking the crispness of a sea breeze. As you journey deeper, middle notes of melon, pineapple, amber, and black currant emerge, painting a picture of tropical indulgence against a backdrop of azure waters. These scents intertwine seamlessly, creating a symphony of sweetness and sophistication that lingers on the skin like a gentle caress.

The base notes of musk, vanilla, galbanum, and petitgrain anchor the fragrance, adding a touch of depth and complexity reminiscent of the coastal landscape. With Haramain Amber Oud Aqua Dubai, every spritz is an invitation to immerse yourself in the vibrant energy and timeless elegance of Dubai's aquatic allure.

name: Miss Dior Originale Harrods 175 Anniversary Edition Amphora
desc: Miss Dior Originale Harrods 175 Anniversary Edition Amphora Eau de Toilette by Dior, released in 2024, is classified as a fragrance for women and belongs to the Green and Floral families. The perfumer behind this creation is Francis Kurkdjian.

name: Chanel No 5 Eau de Parfum 2024 Limited Edition
desc: For the 2024 holiday season, Chanel reimagines the iconic No 5 Eau de Parfum in a breathtakingly delicate and exclusive design. The legendary bottle is cloaked in a soft dusting of snow: a handmade veil of silk drapes over the bottle’s shoulders and cabochon, giving it an ethereal and sculptural appearance.

name: Outlands
desc: Outlands by The House of Amouage is a fragrance that invites wearers to explore the unknown. Crafted by Cécile Zarokian, this scent opens with invigorating notes of bright citruses and zesty lemon. As the fragrance develops, rich patchouli adds depth and complexity, while an amber accord with balsams and resins rounds out the composition, creating a deep and layered scent experience.

name: Les Exclusifs de Chanel Cuir de Russie 1924
Estrella de la Manana
desc: Estrella de la Manana by Une Nuit Nomade is a new fragrance for both women and men, released in 2024. It is part of the 'Collection Legends' and offers a unique blend of benzoin, birch, cocoa, and vanilla notes.
gender: women and men. This is a new fragrance. Estrella de la Manana was launched in 2024. The nose behind this fragrance is Jérôme Di Marino. The fragrance features Cocoa, Birch, Benzoin and Vanilla

name: Aventus
desc:
Aventus celebrates strength, vision and success, inspired by the dramatic life of war, peace and romance lived by Emperor Napoleon. The bottle is emblazoned with a silver emblem of a horse and rider.

The finest ingredients were hand-selected for this composition, and father and son developed this provocative, masculine and optimistic fragrance as a joint effort.

Top notes: blackcurrant, bergamot, apple and pineapple. Heart: rose, dry birch, Moroccan jasmine and patchouli. Base: oak moss, musk, ambergris, and vanilla.

Aventus is available in flacons of 30, 75, 120 and 250 ml.

name: Supremacy Collector's Edition Pour Homme
desc: Supremacy Collector's Edition, a captivating fragrance that honors the legacy of our beloved Supremacy collection. This exquisite scent combines the classic allure of a timeless classic with a refreshing twist of white floral and amber notes.
gender: men. This is a new fragrance

name: Fahrenheit 32
desc: After Fleur du Male, launched by Jean Paul Gaultier, Christian Dior released a new, spring version of Fahrenheit 32, which is also a floral. Florals are finally in fashion in masculine fragrances. Both fragrances have orange blossom as a dominating note along with woody notes harmonized by a fresh accord. Its special floral freshness combines orange blossom with incensy, woody and fresh notes which we also find in aromatic Fleur du Male by Jean Paul Gaultier and oriental Fahrenheit 32. Among main perfume notes in the new Fahrenheit fragrance, are iris, rose, violet, orange blossom, vetiver and vanilla. This gentle and light masculine composition can also be interesting to women. It was launched in 2007.
gender: men. Fahrenheit 32 was launched in 2007. Fahrenheit 32 was created by François Demachy and Louise Turner. Top note is Orange Blossom; middle note is Vetiver; base note is Vanilla

name: Nosferatu
desc: Nosferatu by Heretic Parfum, released in 2024, is a unisex fragrance that belongs to the woody and floral families. This composition, crafted by perfumer Douglas Little, features ambrette and lilac as the top notes, with heart notes of nagarmotha, violet, iris, and petrichor, and a base of labdanum, grey amber, and oud.
